svg.title: Monte Carlo wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / MONTE CARLO
Seeded trials with a chosen sampling method.
The same seed and method must return the same success rate and the same percentiles.
Each trial stores its yearly path and is replayable from the
Duration 4.2 s · seed 1234 · historical random restart
Cancel stops the job and discards partial statistics.
Seed, trial count, and method are stored with the run. Repeating seed 1234 with 100 trials returns identical
The band is p10 to p90 from the backend. The median line is drawn from the stored percentile values, never from
Trial rows open the stored yearly path for that trial, including failed trials.
Success rate and every percentile come from one response, so the KPI row and the chart cannot disagree.
